title: Normalized integral and condensed counit realization data
statement:
Fix the algebraically closed finite-field and coefficient datum $P$, with coefficient prime $\ell$, of [def-pur-conventions], separated finite-type $k$-schemes $X,Y$ and a compactification $X\xrightarrow jZ\xrightarrow pY$ of a $k$-morphism, with $j$ open and $p$ proper, as in [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting], and $d\in\mathbf N$. For the simultaneous finite-coefficient-field models $D$ and a normalized integral model $m$ at a finite intermediate field $E$ in the fixed algebraic closure of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, use exactly the categories, functors and whole-tower purity map of [det-sp-field-extension-towers], the reduction/total-limit equivalences of [det-sp-normalized-equivalence], and the adjunction of [det-sp-integral-adjunction-bijection]. Define Stage to be the type of a natural isomorphism $\gamma_H:H\cong J$ whose components equal that actual integral gamma, and the adjunction $F\dashv H$ equal to transport of the supplied $F\dashv J$ along $\gamma_H^{-1}$, together with the following equations: its Hom map is $h\mapsto B(h);\gamma_H^{-1}$, its inverse is $a\mapsto F(a;\gamma_H);\epsilon_J$, its unit is $\eta_J;\gamma_H^{-1}$, its counit is $F(\gamma_H);\epsilon_J$, and for every specified adjunction $F\dashv G$ it is $F(\gamma_H;\delta);\epsilon_G$, where $\delta$ is the counit-preserving right-adjoint uniqueness isomorphism. Include its unit and counit reduction equations using exactly the supplied tower left/right comparisons, not separate levelwise lifts.

Use the actual condensed finite-Tor bounded constructible categories of [sk-def-sfb-constructible] for the condensed integral coefficient ring. Condensed, condensedCategory and condensedInclusion are just this existing category, its inherited category structure and its full inclusion. condensedRestriction is the actual restriction of a supplied ambient functor using its preservation certificate. Define condensedSource as the actual derived pullback of [det-sp-integral-direct-image-tower], tensor with the integral Tate line of [def-coefficient-twists-detailed] transported by the completed/section/internal equivalence of [def-pur-integral-smooth-adjunction-presentation], and shift by $2d$. Define CondensedStage(m,A) to consist of equivalences from the two raw integral categories to these condensed categories whose inclusion comparisons are the actual internalization equivalences; preservation of condensed finite-Tor constructibility by literal compactification support and condensedSource; restricted functors F,J equal to these restrictions; an adjunction F adjoint to J; its support and source comparison isomorphisms with A, and the exact unit and counit comparison equations. Include the counit-preserving right-adjoint uniqueness equation for every specified right adjoint to this same F. Finally, when X,Y are Noetherian, towerSource is the actual whole-tower twisted inverse image of [det-sp-tower-gamma], restricted by the supplied purity-domain membership and then the inverse coordinate equivalence. These are types of normalized data and actual restrictions only; their inhabitance is not asserted.
